title: Saffron Air SF-187 cancelled - carrier says refunded weeks ago; card shows no credit

dispute.narrative: My Saffron Air flight SF-187 BOM-GOI was cancelled. I have not received what I am owed.

documents.title: E-ticket / itinerary receipt
documents.text:
E-TICKET / ITINERARY RECEIPT
Passenger: Neha Kapoor
Booking reference (PNR): 9JQ8JU
Flight: SF-187 BOM-GOI departing 26-Sep-2026 21:25 IST
Base fare INR 8,500.00 | Fuel charge INR 850.00 | Taxes and fees INR 620.00
Total paid INR 9,970.00 by credit card

documents.title: Cancellation SMS
documents.text: Dear Neha, Saffron Air regrets that flight SF-187 BOM-GOI scheduled 26-Sep-2026 21:25 IST is cancelled. Sent 26-Sep-2026 07:25 IST.

agent_run.evidence_summary: Booking 9JQ8JU on SF-187; cancellation communicated by the carrier.
agent_run.research_summary: Cancellation by the carrier triggers refund and, depending on notice, compensation.
agent_run.strategy: File a grievance with the carrier's nodal officer; escalate to the regulator if unresolved.
agent_run.appeal_draft: To the Grievance Officer, Saffron Air: I request INR 17,470.00 for the cancellation of SF-187 (PNR 9JQ8JU) on 26 Sep 2026.
review_notes: Citations to be checked against regulation text.
citations: DGCA CAR Section 3, Series M, Part IV - compensation in addition to refund when a cancellation is notified less than 24 hours before departure
CAR Section 3 Series M Part II - refunds within 7 days for credit card purchases
